rationale: A theme-painted <button> in a browser capture now records its UA scheme and disabled state like the existing range, checkbox and radio controls, drops the UA background and border the native theme replaces, and lowers to the ButtonSurface widget in the native and baked C++ lanes instead of a frame. It is a widget choice inside Pulp's own import lowering for one control kind: no Chromium capture flags, DesignIR schema, renderer backend, asset or packaging authority moves, and author-styled buttons and other import lanes are unchanged.
